newsitem.title: INDIA: India allows Hughes Ispat to raise foreign stake.
newsitem.headline: India allows Hughes Ispat to raise foreign stake.

text.p: The Indian government said on Friday it has approved a proposed increase in foreign shareholders' stake in telecommunications firm Hughes Ispat Ltd to 49 percent from 40 percent.
Hughes Ispat is a joint venture linking India's Ispat group, Hughes Electronic Corp and Alltel Corp of the United States. It has paid-up equity capital of 20 billion rupees.
The government said in a statement that the Cabinet Committee on Foreign Investment approved a proposal for the foreign-owned stake to be increased to 9.8 billion rupees from 8.0 billion.
It said the additional equity "is proposed to be subscribed through" Kellerton Ventures Corp, based in the Virgin Islands.
The statement did not say whether Kellerton represented either of the existing foreign partners. Hughes Ispat officials could not be reached for comment.
